name: Burnt Lungs
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (pinch of ash)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause a combustion in the target’s lungs. The target must breathe air and aquatic creatures are immune to this effect. Otherwise, an affected creature takes 6d6 fire damage and is exhausted for the remainder of the duration. They also must make a caster-level check to cast spells with verbal components.

A successful Fortitude save halves this damage and reduces the effect to fatigued for 1d6 rounds.
